findings_note: Resolved 2026-11-08, eight days after the 2026-10-31 due date. Act 22 §9 keeps these outside the Brier score; they are recorded here as the separate review-checkpoint block, with ledger.json#resolutions authoritative. The scorer still prints resolution:'pending' for checkpoints because it hardcodes that value — a reporting defect for the Executive, not a claim that these are unresolved.
note: Act 20 §7 P1–P5 are carried forward from their statutory source into ledger.json as review_checkpoint entries, with the original review date and evidence source. They are not new Act 22 registrations or Brier-scored observations; their checkpoint findings remain separate so the two instruments are not double-counted.
